id: \rI can't wait to get out of here.
en: \rI can't wait to get out of here.
it: \rNon vedo l'ora di andarmene da qui.

id: \rI should stop hiding and go home...
en: \rI should stop hiding and go home...
it: \rDovrei smettere di nascondermi e tornare a casa...

id: \rI want this!
en: \rI want this!
it: \rVoglio questo!

id: \bIt's great that a small town like this can still get supplies.
en: \bIt's great that a small town like this can still get supplies.
it: \bÈ fantastico che una piccola città come questa riceva ancora rifornimenti.

id: \bBeating Clair is going to take a lot of supplies. I don't care how lame it is. Winning is more important than things like growth or a sense of achomplishment.
en: \bBeating Clair is going to take a lot of supplies. I don't care how lame it is. Winning is more important than things like growth or a sense of achomplishment.
it: \bPer battere Sandra mi serviranno un sacco di strumenti. Non m'importa quanto sia patetico. Vincere conta più di cose come la crescita personale o la soddisfazione.

id: \bLeave me alone.
en: \bLeave me alone.
it: \bLasciami in pace.

id: \rPokémon can be good or bad. It depends on the Trainer.
en: \rPokémon can be good or bad. It depends on the Trainer.
it: \rI Pokémon possono essere buoni o cattivi. Dipende dall'Allenatore.

id: \bA lot of people don't come to Marts nowadays. I wonder why.
en: \bA lot of people don't come to Marts nowadays. I wonder why.
it: \bOggigiorno in tanti non vengono più ai Market. Chissà perché.

id: \bThere are wicked people who will use Pokémon for criminal acts.
en: \bThere are wicked people who will use Pokémon for criminal acts.
it: \bCi sono persone malvagie che usano i Pokémon per commettere crimini.

id: \bTeam Rocket is just one example.
en: \bTeam Rocket is just one example.
it: \bIl Team Rocket è solo un esempio.

id: \bMax Repel keeps weaker Pokémon from appearing.
en: \bMax Repel keeps weaker Pokémon from appearing.
it: \bIl Repellente Max impedisce ai Pokémon più deboli di comparire.

id: \bMax Repel stays effective longer than Super Repel.
en: \bMax Repel stays effective longer than Super Repel.
it: \bIl Repellente Max dura più a lungo del Superrepellente.

id: \rDo you sell food here?
en: \rDo you sell food here?
it: \rVendete cibo qui?

id: \rA revive is costly, but it revives fainted Pokémon!
en: \rA revive is costly, but it revives fainted Pokémon!
it: \rUn Revitalizzante costa caro, ma rianima i Pokémon esausti!

id: \rA lot of people just go to Lilycove for their shopping. I like the quiet though.
en: \rA lot of people just go to Lilycove for their shopping.  I like the quiet though.
it: \rIn tanti vanno a fare acquisti a Porto Alghepoli.  Ma a me piace la tranquillità.

id: \bI'm searching for items that raise the stats of Pokémon.
en: \bI'm searching for items that raise the stats of Pokémon.
it: \bSto cercando strumenti che aumentano le statistiche dei Pokémon.

id: \bThey're effective over the course of a single battle.
en: \bThey're effective over the course of a single battle.
it: \bFanno effetto per la durata di una singola lotta.

id: \bX Attack, X Defend, X Speed, and X Special are what I'm after.
en: \bX Attack, X Defend, X Speed, and X Special are what I'm after.
it: \bAttacco X, Difesa X, Velocità X e Att. Speciale X: ecco cosa cerco.

id: \bIt's always a good idea to stock up on Potions.
en: \bIt's always a good idea to stock up on Potions.
it: \bÈ sempre una buona idea fare scorta di Pozioni.

id: \bI need to stock up on potions so that I can beat the Gym. It's not cheating if they let you.
en: \bI need to stock up on potions so that I can beat the Gym.  It's not cheating if they let you.
it: \bDevo fare scorta di Pozioni per battere la Palestra.  Non è barare se te lo lasciano fare.

id: \bSometimes, a Trainer duo will challenge you with two Pokémon at the same time.
en: \bSometimes, a Trainer duo will challenge you with two Pokémon at the same time.
it: \bA volte una coppia di Allenatori ti sfiderà con due Pokémon contemporaneamente.

id: \bI need you to cover for me tomorrow. Please?
en: \bI need you to cover for me tomorrow. Please?
it: \bDomani mi serve che tu mi sostituisca. Per favore?

id: \bRepel not only keeps bugs away, it also works on weak Pokémon.
en: \bRepel not only keeps bugs away, it also works on weak Pokémon.
it: \bIl Repellente non tiene lontani solo gli insetti, funziona anche con i Pokémon deboli.

id: \bPut your strongest Pokémon at the left of the Pokémon List.
en: \bPut your strongest Pokémon at the left of the Pokémon List.
it: \bMetti il tuo Pokémon più forte a sinistra nella lista dei Pokémon.

id: \bIf your first Pokémon is strong, Repel's effect is boosted.
en: \bIf your first Pokémon is strong, Repel's effect is boosted.
it: \bSe il tuo primo Pokémon è forte, l'effetto del Repellente aumenta.

id: \rI've been trying to find stones for some time now. Is this the wrong store?
en: \rI've been trying to find stones for some time now. Is this the wrong store?
it: \rÈ da un po' che cerco delle pietre. Ho sbagliato negozio?

id: \rDo you know about Rare Candy? They don't sell it in shops.
en: \rDo you know about Rare Candy? They don't sell it in shops.
it: \rConosci le Caramelle Rare? Nei negozi non le vendono.

id: \rI think it makes Pokémon grow very quickly all of a sudden.
en: \rI think it makes Pokémon grow very quickly all of a sudden.
it: \rCredo che facciano crescere i Pokémon molto rapidamente, tutto d'un tratto.

id: \bPotions are essential for traveling.
en: \bPotions are essential for traveling.
it: \bLe Pozioni sono indispensabili in viaggio.

id: \rI wonder what I should buy for my Pokémon?
en: \rI wonder what I should buy for my Pokémon?
it: \rChissà cosa dovrei comprare per i miei Pokémon?

id: \rHave you tried using an X Speed? It speeds up a Pokémon in battle.
en: \rHave you tried using an X Speed? It speeds up a Pokémon in battle.
it: \rHai mai provato a usare un Velocità X? Rende un Pokémon più veloce in lotta.

id: \bThe market does have some interesting items, but you can't beat the classics.
en: \bThe market does have some interesting items, but you can't beat the classics.
it: \bIl market ha degli strumenti interessanti, ma i classici sono insuperabili.

id: \bWhat do I want?
en: \bWhat do I want?
it: \bCosa voglio?

id: \bDon't they have anything to advertise the Safari Zone?
en: \bDon't they have anything to advertise the Safari Zone?
it: \bNon hanno niente per pubblicizzare la Zona Safari?

id: \bYou seem nice. Take this.
en: \bYou seem nice. Take this.
it: \bSembri simpatico. Prendi questo.

id: \bGive that to Kurt. He will make something special for you.
en: \bGive that to Kurt. He will make something special for you.
it: \bPortalo a Kurt. Creerà qualcosa di speciale per te.

id: \bHow did you get here? It's been a long time since we've had a visitor. You have to tell me.
en: \bHow did you get here? It's been a long time since we've had a visitor. You have to tell me.
it: \bCome sei arrivato qui? È da tanto che non abbiamo visite. Devi raccontarmelo.

id: \rI need to stock up on potions so that I can get to the Gym.
en: \rI need to stock up on potions so that I can get to the Gym.
it: \rDevo fare scorta di Pozioni per arrivare alla Palestra.

id: \bIgnore my husband. He likes to bother new people.
en: \bIgnore my husband. He likes to bother new people.
it: \bNon dare retta a mio marito. Gli piace importunare i nuovi arrivati.

id: \bWhat gives! They don't sell grapefruits here.
en: \bWhat gives! They don't sell grapefruits here.
it: \bMa insomma! Qui non vendono pompelmi.

id: \bI'm waiting the rain out. I hope they don't make me leave.
en: \bI'm waiting the rain out. I hope they don't make me leave.
it: \bAspetto che smetta di piovere. Spero che non mi caccino.

id: \bAlola! Wait, that's not the saying here...
en: \bAlola! Wait, that's not the saying here...
it: \bAlola! Aspetta, qui non si saluta così...

id: \bHello!
en: \bHello!
it: \bCiao!

id: \bI stocked up on items for my Gym battle, but I didn't need any.
en: \bI stocked up on items for my Gym battle, but I didn't need any.
it: \bHo fatto scorta di strumenti per la lotta in Palestra, ma non mi è servito niente.

id: \bI never have enough money to keep my team healthy.
en: \bI never have enough money to keep my team healthy.
it: \bNon ho mai abbastanza soldi per tenere in salute la mia squadra.

id: \rAll I wanted to buy was a Hyper Potion. I don't have enough badges though.
en: \rAll I wanted to buy was a Hyper Potion. I don't have enough badges though.
it: \rVolevo solo comprare un'Iperpozione. Però non ho abbastanza Medaglie.
